files_and_commits.change: new clang BPF build rule with named UNSUPPORTED gates

host_capability: Windows host has no clang. The bash command is a WSL launcher with no installed distro, so the script cannot run natively here. Docker Desktop 29.1.5 is running and a Linux container supplied the toolchain.
container_toolchain: Ubuntu 22.04, clang 14.0.0-1ubuntu1.1, libbpf-dev, linux-libc-dev, multiarch include /usr/include/x86_64-linux-gnu

tests.name: install the BPF toolchain in the Linux container
tests.command: docker exec sheaf_bpf_build bash -c 'export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; apt-get install -y -qq clang libbpf-dev linux-libc-dev'

tests.name: compile the repository BPF source through a bind mount
inspect the object produced by the bind-mount run
tests.command: docker run --rm -v "C:\Users\thela\OneDrive\Desktop\folder\shelf-db\sheaf-db:/repo" -w /repo sheaf_bpf_toolchain:latest bash -c 'bash scripts/compile_ebpf.sh /tmp/sheaf_vfs.bpf.o && readelf -h /tmp/sheaf_vfs.bpf.o'
tests.output: PASS: compiled native/ebpf/sheaf_vfs.bpf.c to /tmp/sheaf_vfs.bpf.o; ELF Header: Class ELF64; Type REL (Relocatable file); Machine Linux BPF; Number of section headers 27; BIND_VERIFY_EXIT=0

tests.name: UNSUPPORTED gate when clang is absent
tests.command: docker exec sheaf_bpf_build bash -c 'mkdir -p /minimal/bin; ln -sf /usr/bin/dirname /minimal/bin/dirname; env PATH=/minimal/bin /bin/bash /work/scripts/compile_ebpf.sh /work/ebpf/x.o'
tests.output: UNSUPPORTED: eBPF VFS compile cannot run. Missing: clang; UNSUPPORTED_GATE_EXIT=0

tests.name: UNSUPPORTED gate when libbpf headers are absent
tests.command: docker exec sheaf_bpf_build bash -c 'mv /usr/include/bpf /usr/include/bpf.hidden; bash /work/scripts/compile_ebpf.sh /work/ebpf/y.o; mv /usr/include/bpf.hidden /usr/include/bpf'
tests.output: UNSUPPORTED: eBPF VFS compile cannot run. Missing: libbpf headers (bpf/bpf_helpers.h); HEADERS_GATE_EXIT=0

tests.name: host execution attempt
tests.output: WSL ERROR: CreateProcessCommon:735: execvpe(/bin/bash) failed: No such file or directory; HOST_SCRIPT_EXIT=1
tests.result: UNSUPPORTED on this host; the Linux-container run above is the compile gate

artifact: sheaf_vfs.bpf.o, 7536 bytes, Machine Linux BPF, sections .maps, license, tracepoint/syscalls/sys_enter_openat
notes: The script checks clang, the clang BPF target, and the libbpf headers before it prints PASS.
Each absent gate prints an explicit UNSUPPORTED line with the named missing tool and exits without claiming a pass.
The multiarch include directory is added because clang with -target bpf does not add the host path for asm/types.h.
native/ebpf/sheaf_vfs.bpf.c and crates/sheaf-native/build.rs were not modified.
